relationships.evidence_quote: HG significantly decreased the p-TRPV1/TRPV1 ratio in mouse SCs, whereas coculture with HUCMSCs increased this ratio

relationships.subject: HUCMSCs
relationships.evidence_quote: HUCMSCs alleviate HG-induced SC injury by promoting the TRPV1-mediated Ca2+ signaling pathway, reducing apoptosis, and enhancing cell proliferation

relationships.subject: TRPV1

relationships.subject: HUCMSCs
relationships.evidence_quote: TUNEL staining indicated that HG promoted apoptosis in mouse SCs, which was significantly reduced by coculture with HUCMSCs

relationships.subject: AMPK
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest that HUCMSCs alleviate HG-induced SC injury by improving mitochondrial function through AMPK signaling.

relationships.subject: HUCMSCs
relationships.evidence_quote: HUCMSC administration significantly alleviated mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in diabetic mice

key_findings: HUCMSCs relieved mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in diabetic mice, an effect attenuated by the TRPV1 antagonist AMG9810 or AMPK inhibitor compound C.
In high-glucose Schwann cells, HUCMSCs restored TRPV1 phosphorylation, Ca2+ influx and AMPK activation, reduced apoptosis and rescued mitochondrial biogenesis and dynamics.
